mapper.sql: SELECT u.user_no AS userNo , u.sp_user_id AS spUserId , DATE_FORMAT(u.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS createdAt , IFNULL(app.comprehensive_yn, 'Y') AS comprehensiveYn , IFNULL(app.selfreg_yn, 'N') AS selfregYn FROM `user` u LEFT JOIN account_paper_permission app ON app.user_no = u.user_no
mapper.select: /* PaperPermissionAdminMapper.countTeachers */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user` u WHERE u.tc_id IS NOT NULL AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: /* PaperPermissionAdminMapper.upsertPaperPermission */ INSERT INTO account_paper_permission (user_no, comprehensive_yn, selfreg_yn, updated_by) VALUES (#{userNo}, #{comprehensiveYn}, #{selfregYn}, #{updatedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE comprehensive_yn = VALUES(comprehensive_yn), selfreg_yn = VALUES(selfreg_yn), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by), updated_at = NOW()
